tbesh_html:
1) to meet, encounter, approach, be opportune
1a) (Piel) to allow to meet, cause to meet
1b) (Pual) to be sent, be allowed to meet
1c) (Hithpael) to seek occasion (quarrel), cause oneself to meet

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to approach; hence, to meet in various senses
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (perhaps rather identical with H578 (אָנָה) through the idea of contraction in anguish);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: befall, deliver, happen, seek a quarrel.
